title: e2e authoring line — the three skills and their artifacts — plan 001
epic_title: Build the e2e authoring line — a new e2e-design/v1 doc class and an e2e-review-report/v1 family instance; e2e-design (coverage map + per-scenario routes + app-shape harness, input refusals, the no-automatable-surface stop, and live-design-set selection); e2e-review (the fourth reviewer-program instance: two blind lenses over the shared context pack, blocking convergence, and the human conversation half); e2e-plan (a plan-new plan/v1 with a conditional harness task); and the seeded catch corpus — dogfooded design → review → plan on one pyxis feature

tasks.title: The e2e-design/v1 document class and its well-formedness checklist
tasks.goal: One version-pinned e2e-design/v1 document class carries a feature's e2e coverage in six required sections with a header Basis join and per-scenario routes, and a well-formedness checklist accepts a golden doc and rejects each structural defect at its own rule — a lightweight class frozen at approval, off the technical-design index.
tasks.current: No e2e-design document class exists; nothing defines the six-section e2e design doc, its header Basis join, the per-scenario route grammar, or a checklist that tells a well-formed doc from a malformed one.
tasks.desired: A markdown template instantiates the e2e-design/v1 class with a closed section set — Scenarios, Setup and teardown, Mock strategy, Harness libraries, Coverage map, and Per-scenario route — each present, an empty one reading a stated `none — reason`; the header carries the routing pair, a Basis row typing the feature join, the governing-design revision(s) the coverage was derived from, and a Status of draft or approved; a well-formedness checklist accepts a golden doc and rejects a doc missing a section, a coverage-map entry with no scenario or routed disposition, a scenario with two routes, or a manual-human route with no named owner, each at its own rule; the class defines the per-feature home its design doc and review report co-locate in, carries no technical-design-index entry, and holds no Serves or Supersedes design-class semantics.
scope: the e2e-design/v1 template: the six sections plus the header Basis join, governing-design revision(s), and Status rows
the well-formedness checklist — every section present, one route per scenario, a named manual-human owner, each coverage entry carrying a scenario or a routed disposition
the per-feature home the design doc and its review report co-locate in
the class's exclusion from the technical-design index and its lack of design-contract semantics
out_of_scope: the skill behavior that authors the coverage, routes, and harness choice (T3)
whether the coverage map is complete against the feature's required-behavior set — the coverage lens's judgment (T6)
the review report schema (T2) and the plan (T8)
acceptance: the e2e-design/v1 template exists version-pinned with the six sections and the header Basis and governing-design-revision rows
a golden e2e design doc passes the well-formedness checklist
each seeded defect — a missing section, a coverage-map entry with no scenario or route, a scenario with two routes, a manual-human route with no owner — fails at its own rule
the class carries no technical-design-index entry and no Serves or Supersedes semantics
key_interfaces: the e2e-design/v1 template and its version pin
the well-formedness checklist rule set
the e2e design doc header — In one line, Relevant-when, Basis, governing-design revision(s), Status

tasks.title: The e2e-review-report/v1 schema — a review-report family instance
tasks.goal: One e2e-review-report/v1 schema instances the review-report family — closable findings with blocking or advisory severity and a versioned report envelope — validates its own integrity, and persists alongside the design doc without forking the family grammar.
tasks.current: No e2e review-report schema exists; nothing carries the e2e reviewer's findings and dispositions as a family instance, and the existing PRD-typed review report admits only PRD subjects.
tasks.desired: A dedicated e2e-review-report/v1 schema declares its subject as the feature's e2e design, the coverage and anti-gaming lens dimensions, and its own calibration table, sharing the review-report family's closable-finding and versioned-report grammar rather than restating it; each finding carries a blocking or advisory severity and a disposition of resolved or rejected-with-reason; a conformance check rejects a report that restates the family grammar instead of instancing it, and a validator rejects a report carrying an undispositioned finding at approval; the report persists beside the design doc in the per-feature home and rides its introducing change; adding this instance leaves the family's existing schemas untouched.
scope: the e2e-review-report/v1 schema as a review-report family instance — closable findings, a versioned envelope, its own calibration table
the finding severity (blocking or advisory) and disposition (resolved or rejected-with-reason) fields
the family-conformance check validating the instance against the shared grammar
persistence of the report beside the design doc, riding its change
out_of_scope: emitting, converging, or dispositioning findings at runtime — the reviewer behavior (T6, T7)
the design doc class the report reviews (T1)
acceptance: a golden e2e-review-report/v1 validates and shares the family's closable-finding and versioned-report grammar
a report restating the family grammar rather than instancing it is rejected by the conformance check
each finding carries a blocking or advisory severity and a resolved or rejected-with-reason disposition
the review-report family's existing instances are byte-unchanged by adding this one
key_interfaces: the e2e-review-report/v1 schema and its version field
the closable-finding grammar — severity, disposition, acceptance condition — shared with the family
the family-conformance validator

tasks.title: e2e-design authors a valid e2e-design/v1 doc
tasks.goal: The e2e-design skill reads a feature's PRD requirement list, its live technical-design set, and its built code, and authors a valid e2e-design/v1 doc — a coverage map anchored to the PRD requirements, a per-scenario route, and an app-shape-fitting harness named as authored content — reading only a bounded slice, not the whole tree.
tasks.current: No e2e-design skill exists; nothing derives a feature's required-behavior list, maps it to scenarios, routes each scenario, or names a harness for the feature's primary interface.
tasks.desired: Invoked on a fully-implemented feature as its own single command, e2e-design anchors the required-behavior list to the feature's PRD requirement rows, tops it up from the live design set's binding elements and the built code, and writes each of the six sections; every required behavior maps to at least one scenario or an explicit routed disposition, each scenario carries exactly one route of run-for-real, mocked, or manual-human, and an individual behavior it cannot route is surfaced as an open item rather than dropped; the skill reasons about the feature's primary external interface — a web endpoint, a command-line argv-and-stdout, or a library public API — and names a fitting harness and mock approach as authored content, carrying no app-shape-specific branch in skill code; it reads a bounded slice of the changed files and the modules the design set names, a run reaching the bound stops rather than fanning out, and it reads its inputs from committed artifacts rather than session state; it emits the line-step tracking event on completion.
scope: the required-behavior derivation anchored to the PRD rows, topped up from the live design set and built code, each behavior mapped to a scenario or a routed disposition
the per-scenario route assignment and the surfacing of an unroutable individual behavior as an open item
the app-shape reasoning naming a fitting harness and mock approach as authored content, with no per-shape branch in skill code
the bounded read of the changed files and named modules, enforced so a run reaching the bound stops
out_of_scope: refusing on absent inputs and selecting the live design set under ambiguity (T4)
the no-automatable-surface stop (T5)
reviewing the produced doc (T6, T7)
acceptance: on the fixture features e2e-design produces a valid e2e-design/v1 doc whose coverage map carries every PRD-derived required behavior with a scenario or a routed disposition
each produced scenario carries exactly one route, and a seeded not-CI-runnable behavior appears routed mocked or manual-human, never absent
across fixtures of at least two app shapes the harness choice lives in authored content and code inspection finds no per-shape branch
a run reaching the read bound stops rather than reading the whole tree
key_interfaces: the e2e-design skill command and its finished-feature invocation
the coverage-map and per-scenario-route authored structure
the app-shape harness-selection reasoning carried as content
the bounded-read budget

tasks.title: e2e-design input gating — refusals and live-design-set selection
tasks.goal: e2e-design refuses and produces nothing when the PRD, the live technical-design set, or the built code is absent, and reads the live (non-superseded) design set for a feature that has several — refusing only on genuine ambiguity, never on plurality.
tasks.current: e2e-design assumes its inputs are present and a single governing design; nothing refuses a not-yet-implemented feature, a missing PRD or design, or resolves which designs are live when a feature has more than one.
tasks.desired: Before authoring, e2e-design checks its inputs — a missing or unreadable PRD or design makes it refuse naming the input, and a feature whose implementation tasks have not all landed makes it refuse naming the unlanded work, and in every refusal it produces zero documents; when a feature has several technical designs it follows the generated index's liveness and derives coverage from the whole live (non-superseded) set, surfacing or refusing only when a superseded design has no clear live successor or liveness is indeterminable, and never refusing merely because more than one design is live.
scope: the refuse-and-produce-nothing path on an absent or unreadable PRD or design, naming the input
the refuse-and-produce-nothing path on a not-fully-implemented feature, naming the unlanded work
the live (non-superseded) design-set selection following the generated index's liveness
the surface-or-refuse-only-on-genuine-ambiguity rule for a superseded design with no clear successor
out_of_scope: authoring the doc from present, unambiguous inputs (T3)
the no-automatable-surface stop, a distinct produce-nothing case (T5)
acceptance: each missing-input fixture — no PRD, no design, not-yet-implemented — yields a refusal naming the input and zero documents
a fixture feature with two live designs is read as a whole set and yields a valid doc with no refusal
a superseded design with no clear live successor, or indeterminable liveness, yields a surfaced ambiguity or a refusal
no refusal is raised merely because more than one design is live
key_interfaces: the input-presence and implementation-completeness checks
the live-design-set resolver over the generated index's liveness
the ambiguity predicate distinguishing genuine ambiguity from plurality

tasks.title: e2e-design's no-automatable-surface stop
tasks.goal: On a feature with no meaningfully-automatable e2e surface — every required behavior routing to manual, or a pure-doc or refactor change with no end-to-end behavior — e2e-design produces zero e2e documents and signals the operator to stop the pipeline, naming the reason, never a fabricated or manual-only artifact.
tasks.current: e2e-design has no clean-stop path; a feature with nothing to automate would draw a fabricated scenario set or a degenerate manual-only doc.
tasks.desired: When every required behavior routes to manual, or the change is pure-doc or refactor with no end-to-end behavior to exercise, e2e-design produces no e2e documents and emits a stop signal naming the no-automatable-surface reason, telling the operator the downstream review and plan steps must not run; it fabricates no scenario and writes no manual-only artifact, and it preserves the distinction from an individual unroutable behavior, which is surfaced as an open item within an otherwise-automatable feature.
scope: the no-automatable-surface detection — all-manual, or a pure-doc or refactor change with no end-to-end behavior
the produce-nothing-and-stop signal naming the reason and halting the downstream steps
the guarantee of zero fabricated scenarios and no manual-only artifact
out_of_scope: the input-absence refusals and live-set selection (T4)
surfacing an individual unroutable behavior within an automatable feature (T3)
acceptance: an all-manual fixture feature yields zero e2e documents and a stop signal naming the reason
a pure-doc fixture change yields zero e2e documents and a stop signal naming the reason
no fabricated scenario and no manual-only artifact is produced in either case
the stop signal marks the downstream review and plan steps as not-to-run
key_interfaces: the no-automatable-surface predicate
the stop-the-pipeline signal and its named reason

tasks.title: e2e-review — the fourth reviewer-program instance
tasks.goal: e2e-review stands up as the fourth instance of the reviewer program — the shared context pack, blind fresh-context lenses, and scope-locked convergence — running two lenses, coverage and anti-gaming, over an input-only pack and emitting an e2e-review-report/v1, with the convergence round count bounded.
tasks.current: No e2e reviewer exists; nothing maps the e2e design doc and its governing contract onto the context pack, runs e2e-specific lenses, or emits an e2e review report.
tasks.desired: e2e-review declares a new review stage mapping the e2e design doc onto the admitted frozen-subject kind and the feature's PRD and live design set onto governing-peer kinds — all existing admitted kinds, no enum change — and admits no authoring-trail kind, so a lens is never handed the author's reasoning as an answer key; it reuses the sibling-session blind-lens runtime to run two lenses held as data — coverage (every required behavior has a genuine scenario; a missing scenario or a gross over-mapping is flagged) and anti-gaming (a written mock strategy that guts the scenario it names is flagged) — each blind to the other, and emits their closable findings into an e2e-review-report/v1; the scope-locked convergence runs to a bounded round count and a run reaching the cap stops; adding or tuning one lens touches no other lens; it reads its inputs from committed artifacts and emits the review-finding tracking event.
scope: the review-stage declaration mapping the e2e design doc, PRD, and live design set onto existing admitted pack kinds, admitting no authoring-trail kind
the two lenses — coverage and anti-gaming — held as data over the blind fresh-context runtime, each independent of the other
the emission of closable findings into an e2e-review-report/v1
the bounded convergence round count, enforced so a run reaching the cap stops
out_of_scope: blocking-versus-advisory settlement, the human conversation half, and the approval gate (T7)
the report schema itself (T2) and the catch corpus that measures the lenses (T9)
acceptance: e2e-review runs the two blind lenses over the shared pack and emits a valid e2e-review-report/v1
a pack build that would admit an authoring-trail kind is refused, and no lens reads another lens's findings
a seeded coverage gap is flagged by the coverage lens and a seeded hollow scenario by the anti-gaming lens, and a clean control yields neither
the convergence round count is bounded and a run reaching the cap stops
key_interfaces: the e2e review-stage declaration and its admitted-kind mapping
the two lens definitions held as data
the bounded convergence round count

tasks.title: e2e-review — blocking convergence and the human conversation half
tasks.goal: Every e2e-review finding carries blocking or advisory severity and converges to settled — a blocking finding solved in the design or explicitly rejected with a reason, an advisory resolved or rejected — with the operator's conversation comments feeding the same loop, and no design with an open finding advancing to planning.
tasks.current: Nothing converges e2e findings; a finding could be left open, the human review would run separately from the lenses, and an unsettled design could advance to the plan.
tasks.desired: Each finding carries a blocking or advisory severity and a recommendation or acceptance condition; the review-and-converge loop runs until every finding is settled — a blocking finding solved in the design or explicitly rejected with a stated reason, an advisory finding resolved or rejected — and the design is not approved while any finding is open, so no design with an open finding advances to e2e-plan; the operator's comments in the conversation run alongside the unmanned lenses, both feeding one convergence loop; the reviewer is advisory in this version, forcing no downstream automated gate, and it emits the finding-disposition tracking event.
scope: the blocking-or-advisory severity and the settle-or-reject convergence over every finding
the approval gate blocking a design with any open finding from advancing to planning
the human conversation half running alongside the lenses in one convergence loop
the advisory-in-v1 posture, forcing no downstream automated gate
out_of_scope: the lens judgment and report emission the convergence operates over (T6)
the plan the approved design feeds (T8)
acceptance: a blocking finding blocks approval until it is solved or explicitly rejected with a reason
an e2e design doc with any open finding does not advance to e2e-plan
on the dogfood the operator's conversation comments and the unmanned findings settle in one loop and the design reflects both
the reviewer forces no downstream automated gate in this version
key_interfaces: the finding severity and the settle-or-reject disposition
the approval gate over open findings
the one convergence loop joining operator comments and lens findings

tasks.title: e2e-plan — a plan-new plan/v1 with a conditional harness task
tasks.goal: e2e-plan authors an ordinary plan-new plan/v1 from an approved e2e design doc — per-scenario tasks plus a harness task only when the feature's harness does not already exist, each scenario task blocked-by an emitted harness task and none when the harness pre-exists — hands it to plan-new's pipeline unchanged, and refuses on an unapproved doc.
tasks.current: No e2e-plan skill exists; nothing turns an approved e2e design doc into an ordered plan, and nothing decides the harness task and its dependency edges.
tasks.desired: Invoked on an approved e2e design doc as its own single command, e2e-plan writes an ordinary plan-new plan/v1 — one task per scenario, plus a harness task only when the feature's e2e harness does not already exist; when a harness task is emitted every scenario task carries a native blocked-by edge on it, and when the harness already exists the scenario tasks carry no harness-build edge; it hands the plan to plan-new's pipeline — fold, plan-PR, freeze-at-merge, and idempotent projection — reusing the ordinary task and charter schema with no new type, leaving the executor and plan-new unchanged; an unapproved design doc makes it refuse naming the missing approval and produce no plan; it reads its input from the committed approved doc and emits the line-step tracking event.
scope: authoring a plan-new plan/v1 with per-scenario tasks and a conditional harness task
the blocked-by edge on each scenario task when a harness task is emitted, and its absence when the harness pre-exists
handing the plan to plan-new's pipeline, reusing the task and charter schema with no new type
the refusal on an unapproved design doc
out_of_scope: the executor's frontier and plan-new's pipeline, consumed unchanged and not edited
the review and approval that precede planning (T7)
acceptance: on an approved doc with no existing harness, e2e-plan emits per-scenario tasks and one harness task, each scenario task blocked-by it, and the plan folds as a plan-new plan/v1
on an approved doc whose harness already exists, e2e-plan emits zero harness tasks and no scenario task carries a harness-build edge
the produced tasks use the ordinary task and charter schema with no new required field, and plan-new and the executor are byte-unchanged
an unapproved design doc yields a refusal naming the missing approval and zero tasks
key_interfaces: the e2e-plan skill command and its approved-doc invocation
the conditional harness task and the scenario blocked-by edges
the plan-new plan/v1 handoff reusing the task and charter schema

tasks.title: The seeded catch corpus and its catch-rate measurement
tasks.goal: A permanent catch corpus of seeded coverage gaps and hollow scenarios plus clean controls exercises the two lenses and records their catch-rate as a retained measurement, so a lens that stops biting is visible without gating any commit.
tasks.current: No catch corpus exists; nothing measures whether the coverage and anti-gaming lenses actually flag a seeded gap or a hollow scenario, or records the result.
tasks.desired: The corpus ships as permanent fixtures — e2e design docs with seeded coverage gaps (a required behavior with no scenario), seeded hollow scenarios (a mock that guts the behavior the scenario names), and clean controls — run through the two lenses; every seeded gap is flagged by the coverage lens and every seeded hollow scenario by the anti-gaming lens, while clean controls yield no finding; the catch-rate is written as a retained, append-only run record feeding the reviewer's advisory-to-blocking ramp, and it measures rather than gates any commit; it emits the catch-corpus tracking event.
scope: the seeded coverage-gap and hollow-scenario fixtures plus clean controls
the harness running the corpus through the two lenses and scoring flagged-versus-not
the retained, append-only catch-rate run record feeding the advisory-to-blocking ramp
the measure-not-gate posture over commits
out_of_scope: the lenses and the report the corpus exercises (T6)
the reviewer's advisory-to-blocking checkpoint that later reads the record — out of this version
acceptance: every seeded coverage-gap case is flagged by the coverage lens and every seeded hollow-scenario case by the anti-gaming lens
the clean controls yield no coverage or anti-gaming finding
the catch-rate is written as a retained append-only run record
the corpus run records a measurement and gates no commit
key_interfaces: the seeded catch-corpus fixtures and their two case families
the corpus-run harness and its flagged-versus-not scoring
the retained catch-rate run record
